evals.name: ready-branch

evals.expected_output: Runs lint, unit, e2e and build (all pass), notes eval/target-tl006 has no origin copy and falls back to the local branch, flags the schema migration and new controller as approval/manual items, finds the ticket In review with all boxes ticked, and gives a Ready (or Ready with caveats) verdict without committing or pushing.
files: worktree on branch eval/tl-006-ready-N (TL-006 before merge), target eval/target-tl006
assertions: Reports a real result for each of lint, unit tests, e2e tests and build
E2E tests actually ran and are reported as passed with a count
Verdict is Ready or Ready with caveats, not Not ready
Flags the schema/migration change as needing approval
Notes there is no origin copy of eval/target-tl006 and the local branch was used
No commits, pushes or tracked-file edits were made in the worktree
